description: Set the full content blocks array on a page (replaces all existing content blocks). Blocks with matching ids keep their existing content when not provided. Only call after the user confirms. If the result includes blockWarnings, the saved content violates the workspace block manifest (unknown field, wrong value shape, or a stored block whose type is no longer registered) - correct the content and save again, unless the warning is about a stored block whose type is no longer registered: that one is a manifest problem, so restore or sync the type, or find the block with list_block_usage and migrate or remove it. A block whose type the workspace block manifest does not register is refused on the shared draft unless the page already stores that block - compose types that are not deployed yet in target: 'devDraft' and promote once the code ships; pick registered types from list_block_types.

blocks.description: Full array of content blocks to set on the page (replaces all)

target.description: 'draft' (default) writes the shared page draft. 'devDraft' writes YOUR per-user dev draft overlay (owned by the token's user) - use it to compose with block types that are not deployed to the site yet; promote it with promote_dev_draft after the code ships.

name: update_page_blocks
